name: Conveno terminal theme
note: Roles are what the CLI code asks for. truecolor is exact; ansi256 is the nearest xterm-256 index that keeps AA contrast on the matching background; ansi16 uses the plain SGR codes so the user's own terminal theme decides the hue. 'dark' and 'light' name the terminal background. Detect with COLORFGBG or OSC 11 when available; otherwise default to dark.

attributes.bold: SGR 1. Used for names, ticket ids and the one key phrase of a line. Never the only signal.
attributes.dim: Not used. 'quiet' is a colour, because SGR 2 is unreliable across terminals.
attributes.reset: SGR 0 at the end of every coloured span and every line.

entry.use: The accent, reserved for: orchestrator dot, live tier, links, and the spinner's point (the mark's point). Not commands and not the prompt.

ansi16.note: blue; use 94 (bright blue) only when the user's 16-colour theme renders 34 too dark

stamp.use: Needs the owner: open tickets, waiting on a question. Not an error.

warn.use: Works, but will bite later. Always with a fix line.

error.use: Failed or broken. Always with what happened and how to fix it.

info.use: Neutral facts worth a second look: versions, paths, counts.

quiet.use: Timestamps, column heads, hints, separators, idle and offline.

ink.use: Primary text, the busy dot, and commands (bold). Left as the terminal's default foreground; never set explicitly except bold.

ansiPalette.note: The 16 slots Conveno ships in its own terminal theme and the colours mockups are drawn with.

environment.NO_COLOR: Any non-empty value: no colour, no bold. Glyphs stay.
environment.FORCE_COLOR: 0 = off, 1 = 16-colour, 2 = 256, 3 = truecolor. Empty or 'true' = at least 16-colour. Overrides TTY detection, never NO_COLOR.
environment.TERM: 'dumb' or unset: no colour. '*-256color' selects 256. Otherwise 16.
environment.CONVENO_ASCII: 1 forces the ASCII glyph column and the ASCII spinner.
environment.CONVENO_NO_MOTION: 1 disables the spinner and prints the static 'c─── ●' line. CI, a non-TTY stdout, or NO_COLOR with TERM=dumb do the same.

shapes.orchestrator: filled dot (entry), the only blue status

status.note: Orchestrator is the only blue status. Same five shapes as the status-* icons and the UI chips.

spinner.name: entry-write

color.note: The c and the entry line are quiet; only the final point is entry (the mark's point).

spinner.noMotion: Static 'c─── ●' line when CONVENO_NO_MOTION=1, CI is set, stdout is not a TTY, or NO_COLOR with TERM=dumb.

redaction.note: Fixed text, inverse video when colour is on.
